title: 高盛CEO：财富与资管平台规模超4万亿美元，增长引擎何在？
speaker: David Solomon

segments.en: A lot of the growth in the business is undoubtedly from the capital markets sort of business.
segments.zh: 业务增长很大程度来自资本市场业务。

segments.en: What about when it comes to asset wealth management? Are you more of a pivot now for in terms of where you get your earnings growth? Goldman Sachs laid out eight years ago, this leadership team laid out
segments.zh: 资管业务呢？现在盈利增长更依赖这方面吗？高盛八年前，这届管理层制定了

segments.en: a strategy to really grow Goldman Sachs. We've taken the revenue from kind of 34 billion, 35 billion, going back to 2018 when this leadership team came in, the street consensus for the firm is
segments.zh: 真正发展高盛的战略。自2018年这届管理层上任以来，营收从约340亿、350亿美元增长，而市场对该公司今年的普遍预期是

segments.en: somewhere in the low 70s this year. So we've grown the revenue very materially, grown the earnings very materially over that period of time. I think that compounded revenue
segments.zh: 略高于700亿美元。所以这段时间我们营收和盈利都大幅增长。我认为复合营收

segments.en: growth rate is in the nines over that period of time, and the earnings growth is slightly higher.
segments.zh: 增长率在9%左右，盈利增长略高一些。

segments.en: And so we've been very focused on growing the firm. One of the places that we've gotten that growth from. We've gotten the growth really from two places. One, our core banking and markets
segments.zh: 所以我们非常专注于公司增长。增长主要来自两个地方。一是我们的核心银行与市场

segments.en: business. We've really been able to grow market share and take more market share in that business.
segments.zh: 业务。我们确实扩大了市场份额，在该业务中占据了更多份额。

segments.en: But secondarily, we've got a very powerful asset wealth management platform. We supervise over $4 trillion of assets, and that platform's growing. We've stated publicly that we're confident we
segments.zh: 其次，我们拥有强大的资管平台。我们管理超过4万亿美元资产，该平台正在增长。我们公开表示有信心

segments.en: can grow at high single digits, but it's actually growing faster than that. And so the growth in assets around the world, the growth in wealth around the world, we have a very powerful
segments.zh: 能实现高个位数增长，但实际增长更快。全球资产和财富增长，我们拥有非常强大的

segments.en: ultra high net worth platform. We supervise over $2 trillion of wealth for very wealthy individuals around the world. Those platforms are growing quickly, and that's supporting the overall revenue
segments.zh: 超高净值平台。我们为全球非常富有的个人管理超过2万亿美元财富。这些平台增长迅速，支撑了整体营收

segments.en: and earnings growth from the firm. That's been part of our strategy for the last seven or eight years.
segments.zh: 以及公司的盈利增长。这是我们过去七八年战略的一部分。
